title: add-invocation-dependency-graph-and-slo-annotator
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Introduces a compact invocation dependency graph generator and an SLO annotator that tags spans with SLO-impact metadata. Adds dashboard panels for invocation dependency visualizations and a lightweight debug view. No public API breaking changes. Backfilled telemetry for last 7 days in staging.
description:
Motivation: debugging cross-service latency and token-cost regressions is painful when spans are viewed in isolation. This PR introduces a lightweight invocation dependency graph assembled from sampled spans and an SLO annotator that marks spans/edges with estimated SLO impact and cost attribution. The goal is a compact, queryable representation that helps oncall and platform engineers rapidly identify causal edges (e.g., expensive kernel, kv-cache contention, network fanout) without pulling full traces for every incident.

What this change does (summary): builds a dependency graph generator in telemetry-service that consumes sampled OpenTelemetry spans, collapses long chains into per-invocation nodes, and emits edge-level metrics (latency_ms, token_cost_est, span_count). Adds an SLO annotator that evaluates each edge against configured per-route SLOs and adds labels (slo_hit|slo_miss, slo_delta_ms, slo_contrib_pct). Exposes a compact debug endpoint (/invocation-graph/{invocation_id}) used by the Console. Adds dashboard panels and runbook snippets.

Key design/implementation notes: the graph generator is tuned for minimal memory and serves two sampling modes: 1) lightweight sampled mode (1/1000 invocations by default) that emits per-edge metrics and a compressed adjacency payload; 2) on-demand full reconstruction when a synthetic id is pinned by the Console for investigation. Edge cost estimation uses token-phase attribution heuristics already present in token-cost service, with conservative fallbacks when KV cache info is missing. The annotator runs as a separate small pipeline stage so it can be disabled per-environment.

Files changed (high level): telemetry-service/src/graph_gen.rs (new); telemetry-service/src/slo_annotator.rs (new); telemetry-service/tests/graph_gen_integration.rs (new); console/api/invocation_graph_handler.go (new endpoint); console/frontend/src/components/InvocationGraphPanel.tsx (ui); dashboards/observability/invocation-graph.json (dashboard); docs/observability/invocation-graph.md (docs & runbook); deployment/helm/telemetry-values.yaml (feature flag + sampling defaults).

Commit summary: (squashed into a single merge) - add graph generator and edge metrics pipeline - implement SLO annotator and config wiring - wire Console endpoint and front-end panel - add dashboards and runbook - integration tests and CI fixes

Testing and rollout plan: unit and integration tests added. CI pipeline: build -> unit tests -> telemetry integration -> e2e-staging. Staging rollout enabled with feature flag telemetry.graph_enabled=false by default in prod; ramp plan: 0% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% across weeks while validating traffic and cardinality. We backfilled 7 days of compressed graphs in staging to sanity-check cardinality and storage impact.

Observability and cost controls: default sampling set to 1/1000; edge rollups are time-windowed and capped per-tenant. Added cardinality guard rails and metric rate limits to avoid blowups on noisy routes. Added a console warning when a tenant exceeds configured edge budget.

Dashboard and alert changes: new panels in dashboards/observability/invocation-graph.json: Invocation Dependency Heatmap, Top SLO-Contributing Edges, Invocation Graph Size Per Tenant. Added optional alert (disabled by default) slo-edge-spike: fires when top-edge slo_contrib_pct spikes > 30% over baseline for > 5m. Alert tuning notes in docs/observability/invocation-graph.md.

Backward compatibility and safety: no changes to public API endpoints used by customers. Graph generator and annotator are behind a controlled feature flag. Edge metrics are emitted to internal metric namespaces with tenant isolation.

CI summary: All checks passed in the final run. Flaky test telemetry::graph_integration was stabilized by reducing dependency on wall-clock in test harness. Metrics smoke tests validated the expected set of labels for slo annotation.

Review thread (condensed): initial review by Liam requested stronger deduping of repeated edges and clearer guard rails for cardinality; implemented an LRU-based edge coalescer and added tenant budget metrics. Rhea requested better error handling in the Console when invocation reconstruction fails; added 503 fallback with a short explanation and a retry button. Carlos asked for explicit unit tests around slo delta computation across token phases; added two unit tests covering prefix vs streaming token attribution.

Post-merge/operational notes: feature flag will be enabled in prod 2024-12-01 for 10% traffic after infra runbook checks. Monitoring dashboards and alerts shipped; SRE runbook updated with steps to mute the slo-edge-spike alert and to disable graph emission per-tenant.

Related work: ENG-3145 (invocation sampling baseline), ENG-3201 (token-phase cost attribution), SUP-1221 (customer incident that motivated faster edge-level RCA).
